icons_and_assets.instructions: Use Lucide React for UI elements. Use 'Terminal' for log icon, 'Play' for start, 'Square' for stop, 'Globe' for pages, 'ShieldAlert' for errors. Stroke width strictly 1.5.

accessibility.aria: Add aria-live='polite' to the terminal log container. Ensure all buttons have explicit aria-labels if relying purely on icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page React app focusing on a strict 'Control Room' grid layout.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for fonts. Install '@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans' and '@fontsource/jetbrains-mono'. Use IBM Plex Sans for UI text and JetBrains Mono for logs and stats.
Implement the UI using pure Tailwind CSS utility classes mirroring the GitHub Dark specifications provided in this JSON.
The layout must not scroll at the page level. Container is 'h-screen overflow-hidden'. Only the Terminal panel and the Pages grid panel should scroll independently.
The Terminal panel must automatically scroll to the bottom upon new log entries.
Implement live mock data feed simulating WebSocket if backend is not yet attached, triggering card and log pop-ins dynamically.
Apply `data-testid` to all forms, inputs, buttons, and individual log entries for robust QA.
Images for scraped page cards should be displayed using base64 rendering, fallback to an empty state placeholder if missing.

empty_state_terminal.description: Matrix terminal background. Can be used as a low-opacity watermark in the terminal window before crawling starts.

empty_state_dashboard.description: Dark server room. Can be used as an atmospheric background for the empty state of the Pages Grid.
